trap.label: passiva de relato
trap.wrong: It says that the river never sleeps.
trap.right: It is said that the river never sleeps.
trap.why: Em português “diz-se” ou “dizem que”. Em inglês, use it + passiva (is said that), pois não existe sujeito indeterminado “eles”.

mcq.q: It ___ said that the river never sleeps.
The river is said ___ never sleep.

opts: They is believed that it works.
It is believed that it works.

mcq.q: It is estimated ___ one in six…

fix.wrong: It says that the river never sleeps.
fix.right: It is said that the river never sleeps.

fix.wrong: The river is said that never sleeps.
fix.right: The river is said to never sleep.

fix.wrong: It is believed to that it works.
fix.right: It is believed that it works.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “People say that the river never sleeps.”
rewrite.answer: It is said that the river never sleeps.

rewrite.prompt: Sujeito: “People believe that it works.” (It is …)
rewrite.answer: It is believed that it works.

rewrite.prompt: Com to: “It is said that the river is deep.” (The river is said …)
rewrite.answer: The river is said to be deep.
